_howto: Launchpad how-to guides (listed under How-to guides in the ? menu, top right). mode click = the user clicks the real button. optional = skipped when that item isn't on screen (e.g. no access). Never reuse a step id.

guides.title: Find a screen and pin favourites
guides.blurb: Jump straight to any screen, and keep up to 5 favourites one click away.

steps.title: The search bar
steps.text: Click in the search bar.

steps.title: Your screens
steps.text: Before you type, it shows your most visited screens (or suggestions when you are new). Click a card to open that screen.

steps.title: Pin a favourite
steps.text: Point at a card and click its pin (top corner) to keep it here. You can pin up to 5 screens; click the pin again to unpin.

steps.title: Or type
steps.text: Type what you need, like leave, roster or payslip, and pick a result (or use the arrow keys and Enter). Only screens you have access to are listed.

guides.title: Update my profile or password
guides.blurb: Change your name or email, see your employee record, or set a new password.

steps.title: Your menu
steps.text: Click your name at the top right to open your menu.

steps.title: Profile
steps.text: Click Profile.

steps.title: Your account
steps.text: Your photo (or initials), name, role and company. Previous sign-in shows when you last logged in before this time - if you don't recognise it, change your password.

steps.title: Your details
steps.text: Change your first name, last name or email address here. If your login is linked to an employee, My employee record below shows your PIN, department and position; HR keeps those up to date.

steps.title: Security
steps.text: To change your password, click Security.

steps.title: Current password first
steps.text: Type your current password, then the new one twice. The eye shows what you typed. (Forgotten it? Ask an administrator to reset it in Settings > Users. After 5 wrong tries it locks for 15 minutes.)

steps.title: The rules
steps.text: Each rule ticks green as you type: at least 8 characters, a symbol, both passwords the same, and different from the old one. The bar shows how strong it is.

steps.title: Save
steps.text: Save Changes lights up once you have changed something and everything is filled in correctly. When you click it you'll be asked for your current password to confirm it's you (when changing your password, the one on the Security tab is used). Nothing is changed until then, so Cancel is safe if you were only practising.

guides.title: Switch dark or light mode
guides.blurb: Pick the look you like; it follows you to every computer.

steps.title: Your menu
steps.text: Click your name at the top right to open your menu.

steps.title: Dark Mode
steps.text: Flip the Dark Mode switch. It is saved to your account, so every screen and every computer you log in on uses it.

guides.title: See and act on notifications
guides.blurb: What the bell shows and how to handle what is waiting.

steps.title: The bell
steps.text: The red number is how many requests are waiting for you. Click the bell.

steps.title: What is waiting
steps.text: One line per kind of request (leave, profile updates, attendance exceptions) with how many there are. Click a line to open Mobile Requests in ESS Master and approve or decline them. When nothing is waiting it says You're all caught up.

steps.title: View all
steps.text: View all opens the full Mobile Requests list. A request leaves the bell once it has been handled.

guides.title: Connect a phone or get the app
guides.blurb: Download the app and link a phone by scanning a QR code.

steps.title: Your menu
steps.text: Click your name at the top right to open your menu.

steps.title: Download the App
steps.text: Download the App shows a QR code. Scan it with the phone's camera to install the app.

steps.title: Connect a Phone
steps.text: Then Connect a Phone shows a QR code that links the app to your company. Open the app and scan it. (Only shown if you are allowed to connect phones.)
